title: Diagnosing a slow Spark job: plan, then metrics, then layout, then settings
purpose: Spark performance diagnosis order. Read the physical plan; Check stage metrics for spill and skew; Fix code or table layout; Adjust settings last; The four symptoms and their fingerprints.
accessibleSummary: Spark performance diagnosis order. Read the physical plan; Check stage metrics for spill and skew; Fix code or table layout; Adjust settings last; The four symptoms and their fingerprints.
longDescription: Spark performance diagnosis order. Read the physical plan; Check stage metrics for spill and skew; Fix code or table layout; Adjust settings last; The four symptoms and their fingerprints.

nodes.label: 1. Read the physical plan
nodes.summary: The physical plan is the first place to look, and EXPLAIN never executes the query.
nodes.detail: The physical plan is the first place to look, and EXPLAIN never executes the query.
nodes.whyItMatters: The physical plan is the first place to look, and EXPLAIN never executes the query.

evidence.note: EXPLAIN compiles and optimizes without executing, making plan inspection safe on production tables.
FORMATTED prints a plan outline plus per-node detail; COST prints statistics that explain the join choice.

processing: Compile the plan without running it
drill.example: EXPLAIN FORMATTED reveals a sort-merge join where the author assumed a broadcast.
failureModes: Reading only the initial plan misses the final adaptive plan AQE actually executed.

nodes.label: 2. Check stage metrics
nodes.summary: Stage metrics reveal spill, skew and task-count problems directly.
nodes.detail: Stage metrics reveal spill, skew and task-count problems directly.
nodes.whyItMatters: Stage metrics reveal spill, skew and task-count problems directly.

evidence.note: Execution memory exhaustion causes sorts, joins and aggregations to spill to disk.
Skewed partitions exceed the median partition size by a large factor.

processing: Compare max task duration against the percentile spread
outputs: A specific resource or distribution diagnosis
drill.example: A stage where one task ran ten times longer than the median is a skew problem, not a sizing problem.
failureModes: Treating a skew symptom as under-provisioning leads to scaling a cluster that stays idle.

nodes.label: 3. Fix the code or the layout
nodes.summary: Most real wins come from fixing code or table layout, not configuration.
nodes.detail: Most real wins come from fixing code or table layout, not configuration.
nodes.whyItMatters: Most real wins come from fixing code or table layout, not configuration.

evidence.note: A cast on a join key, a Python UDF, or a missing OPTIMIZE explains more slow jobs than any configuration value does.
openCostInBytes compensates for small files at read time but does not fix the underlying problem.

processing: Correct the query or the table layout
outputs: A structural fix rather than a workaround
drill.example: Removing a cast from the join key restores predicate pushdown and halves the scan.
failureModes: Skipping to configuration leaves the real defect in place and the gain temporary.

nodes.label: 4. Change settings last
nodes.summary: Fabric's defaults are good, and pasted settings often defeat adaptive execution.
nodes.detail: Fabric's defaults are good, and pasted settings often defeat adaptive execution.
nodes.whyItMatters: Fabric's defaults are good, and pasted settings often defeat adaptive execution.

evidence.note: The common failure mode is a team pasting settings from a blog into every notebook and defeating AQE.
The Fabric Runtime adds built-in query enhancements and an intelligent cache on top of open-source Spark.

drill.example: Raising the advisory partition size for a very large scan, after confirming spill is not the issue.
failureModes: Setting a value already at its default pins it and hides future engine improvements.

nodes.label: PushedFilters is empty
nodes.summary: An empty PushedFilters list means the scan is reading everything.
nodes.detail: An empty PushedFilters list means the scan is reading everything.
nodes.whyItMatters: An empty PushedFilters list means the scan is reading everything.

evidence.note: PushedFilters:[] means predicate pushdown failed and the scan reads everything.
Casting the column rather than the literal prevents Spark pushing the filter into the scan.

inputs: A scan node in the plan
outputs: Confirmation of pushdown success or failure
drill.example: Casting a string column to date in the predicate blocks pushdown; casting the literal instead restores it.
failureModes: A full scan on a large table dominates runtime while the plan otherwise looks reasonable.

nodes.label: BatchEvalPython appears
nodes.summary: A row-at-a-time Python UDF breaks fusion, serializes rows and forces native fallback.
nodes.detail: A row-at-a-time Python UDF breaks fusion, serializes rows and forces native fallback.
nodes.whyItMatters: A row-at-a-time Python UDF breaks fusion, serializes rows and forces native fallback.

evidence.note: A single unsupported expression such as a Python UDF drops the whole enclosing operator to JVM execution.
CODEGEN mode confirms whether whole-stage fusion applied.

inputs: A projection or filter containing a UDF
outputs: A named fusion and fallback cause
drill.example: Replacing a Python UDF with a built-in expression restores both codegen fusion and native execution.
controls: Arrow or pandas UDFs where unavoidable
failureModes: The damage is attributed to the UDF alone, understating the lost operator-level acceleration.

nodes.label: SortMergeJoin on a small side
nodes.summary: A sort-merge join on a small side pays two sorts and two shuffles unnecessarily.
nodes.detail: A sort-merge join on a small side pays two sorts and two shuffles unnecessarily.
nodes.whyItMatters: A sort-merge join on a small side pays two sorts and two shuffles unnecessarily.

evidence.note: AQE converts sort-merge to broadcast hash join when runtime statistics show a side is small enough.

inputs: A join node in the plan
processing: Compare planned strategy against measured sizes
outputs: A justified or unjustified join strategy
drill.example: The initial plan shows sort-merge but the final adaptive plan shows the broadcast AQE chose.
failureModes: An explicit broadcast hint bypasses AQE's runtime safety check and can OOM the driver.

nodes.label: No AdaptiveSparkPlan wrapper
nodes.summary: A missing adaptive plan wrapper means no runtime re-optimization happened.
nodes.detail: A missing adaptive plan wrapper means no runtime re-optimization happened.
nodes.whyItMatters: A missing adaptive plan wrapper means no runtime re-optimization happened.

evidence.note: AQE is enabled by default since Spark 3.2.0 and provides coalescing, join conversion and skew handling.

processing: Check for the adaptive plan wrapper
outputs: Confirmation that runtime re-optimization is active
drill.example: A plan with no adaptive wrapper gets none of the three runtime corrections.
failureModes: Disabling AQE to make plans deterministic forfeits coalescing, join conversion and skew splitting.

edges.label: Plan narrows where to look in the metrics
Spill or skew points at code or layout
Empty pushed filters visible in the scan
Python evaluation node visible in the plan
Join strategy visible in the plan
Missing adaptive wrapper visible in the plan
